BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,333,759 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities. The transactions occurred on April 9, 2026, with the highest price paid per share being 855.4000 pence and the lowest at 818.2000 pence, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 832.0700 pence per share. These shares were bought from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc as part of a share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026. All purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 09 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
